technical_change: CVE-2026-12342 (GHSA-m924-m654-f267): unauthenticated remote code execution on the IdentityIQ server, caused by improper input validation (CWE-20) of content submitted to the web service API. CVSS v3.1 base score 9.6 (Critical). GitHub Advisory Database / NVD describe it as impacting all versions of IdentityIQ; no fixed version is listed on the advisory itself. GHSA status: Unreviewed.
who_is_affected: On-premises IdentityIQ customers whose IdentityIQ web service API is network-reachable.
implementation_impact: Third-party security-news aggregators (not independently verified by this run — see notes) report SailPoint has released a fix identified as IIQSR-983 for supported IdentityIQ versions. sailpoint.com/security-advisories and community.sailpoint.com, which would carry the authoritative vendor advisory and patch instructions, were unreachable this run (DNS/egress blocked in this sandbox) and could not be opened to confirm patch details first-hand.

technical_change: CVE-2026-12341 (GHSA-7mfg-3gc5-q3w2): unauthenticated attacker can gain access to protected APIs and data due to improper validation of OAuth bearer tokens (CWE-287). CVSS v3.1 base score 8.8 (High). Described as impacting all versions of IdentityIQ; no fixed version listed on the advisory. GHSA status: Unreviewed.
who_is_affected: On-premises IdentityIQ customers exposing IdentityIQ APIs that rely on OAuth bearer token auth.
implementation_impact: Same caveat as the companion CVE-2026-12342 finding: SailPoint's own advisory page could not be opened this run (egress blocked), so patch/remediation detail is unconfirmed first-hand.
